mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales below their 6-month moving averages indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE declines in a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts fall below 1,000,000 units, it indicates a contraction in the housing market and weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where HOUST falls below 1000.0 units.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index exceeding 0.5% indicates a monetary policy response to accelerating inflation that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), a decline in industrial production indicates worsening supply conditions that disrupt corporate operations and reduce earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines in a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 100.0).
